info.title: Better Auth
info.description:
Production API reference for the Better Auth instance mounted under the server URL shown below.

This specification documents the exact Better Auth endpoints exposed by this application, including core authentication flows and enabled plugins. Use it for interactive testing in Swagger or Scalar, client generation, and backend integration work.

Authentication behavior:
- Browser flows primarily rely on Better Auth cookies.
- Some endpoints also accept bearer tokens when your integration uses token-based access.
- OAuth callback endpoints must match the redirect URIs configured with each provider.

The schema intentionally preserves Better Auth request and response contracts as generated by the Open API plugin.

name.description: Display name stored for the user.

email.description: Primary email address for the user.

emailVerified.description: Whether Better Auth has verified the email address.

image.description: Profile image URL when one has been set.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user record was last updated.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether two-factor authentication is enabled for the user.

User.description: Better Auth user model returned by session and account endpoints.

token.description: Session token associated with the active Better Auth session.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the session was last refreshed or updated.

ipAddress.description: IP address recorded for the session, when available.

userAgent.description: User agent recorded for the session, when available.

userId.description: Identifier of the user who owns the session.

Session.description: Better Auth session model for the currently authenticated device or token.

Account.description: OAuth or credential account record linked to a Better Auth user.

Verification.description: Verification token record used internally by Better Auth for email and password flows.

TwoFactor.description: Two-factor configuration record stored for a Better Auth user.

message.description: Human-readable error message returned by Better Auth.

apiKeyCookie.name: apiKeyCookie
apiKeyCookie.description: HTTP cookie managed by Better Auth for browser-based session flows. Cookies are commonly set after successful sign-in, OAuth callback completion, magic-link verification, or other session-creating flows.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer session token for integrations that authenticate with an Authorization header instead of browser cookies. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when your Better Auth setup exposes token-based access.

BadRequestError.description: Bad Request. The submitted parameters are missing, malformed, or otherwise invalid for this Better Auth endpoint.

UnauthorizedError.description: Unauthorized. Authentication is missing, invalid, expired, or not sufficient for this operation.

ForbiddenError.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action.

NotFoundError.description: Not Found. The requested Better Auth resource or provider-specific record could not be found.

UnprocessableEntityError.description: Unprocessable Entity. Better Auth rejected the request because the payload failed validation.

TooManyRequestsError.description: Too Many Requests. Better Auth rate limiting or provider throttling prevented the request from completing.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error. Better Auth or an upstream provider failed while processing the request.

servers.description: Base URL for Better Auth endpoints. Every path in this document is relative to this server URL.

x-codeSamples.label: Update user profile
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3001/api/auth/update-user" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sess_live_01HZX8SV6NQW8D2PR8Y8K2D0M3" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Alice Johnson",
    "image": "https://cdn.example.com/avatars/alice-updated.jpg"
  }'

x-codeSamples.label: Link GitHub
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3001/api/auth/link-social" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sess_live_01HZX8SV6NQW8D2PR8Y8K2D0M3" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "github",
    "callbackURL": "http://localhost:3000/settings/accounts",
    "errorCallbackURL": "http://localhost:3000/settings/accounts?error=oauth",
    "disableRedirect": true
  }'
